title: Approximate Recall, Approximate Forecasts: Recall as a Diagnostic for LLM Forecasting Errors
summary: Across thousands of model-market rows, higher local recall fidelity is associated with lower Brier loss, with wrong recall associated with higher loss.
ai_technology: Four frozen language models produce event probabilities and historical recall answers
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Four frozen language models produce event probabilities and historical recall answers; recall fidelity is linked to forecast loss.; Across thousands of model-market rows, higher local recall fidelity is associated with lower Brier loss, with wrong recall associated with higher loss.; Fixed-effects analyses, resolved outcomes, and recall-error decompositions validate the measured association; it is not prospective market performance.
evidence.unknown: External generalization, independent replication and downstream real-world impact were not established by the reviewed source.
